_about: Corrections to the Sync auto-dub. 'lines' are re-voiced with a clone of that character's own dub voice (samples in 'characters' are taken from the dub itself); 'edits' restore the original actor (names, screams) or trim stray dub words. start/end = seconds in the clip's English track.

MOTHER.note: woman on the stairs (Janko's mother), only line in 88514; clone from her dub line + her original Hungarian line (6 s)

lines.tts: Bring me my bracer, then do what your mother says, understand?

lines.en: I let you kill it.

lines.en: But in truth, it belongs to you, my love.

lines.note: client r3: not manly enough -> HUNYADI2 (actor's own voice); r4: robotic -> calmer take (st 0.55, sim 0.9, natural 127 Hz), lowered 1.7 st with PSOLA to 115 Hz (actor's own line is ~154 Hz)

lines.note: client r4: robotic at ~12 s (2-word splice lowered 7 st) -> whole sentence from one HUNYADI2 take (st 0.75, sim 0.9: smooth contour, no spikes), PSOLA -3 st to ~114 Hz (actor's original ~105 Hz)

lines.en: So you're Mihály's sister? Little Erzsébet Szilágyi.
lines.tts: So you're Mihai's sister? Little Erzhebet Szilagyi.

lines.en: Is Sigismund here yet?
lines.tts: Is Sigismund here yet?
lines.was: Je l' Zigismund već tu? (new Hunyadi voice; timed to the original)
lines.note: client r5: too posh English -> 'already' was always said with the British 'awl' vowel, so the line is now 'Is Sigismund here yet?' (Serbian 'već'); take L08d_t1 (st 0.5, sim 0.95): American 'r' in 'here', least English-sounding of 34 takes, naturally deep (~101 Hz, no pitch shift); emphasis peak on 'SIG' tamed (swings x0.75)

lines.en: Is Sigismund here yet?
lines.tts: Is Sigismund here yet?
lines.note: round 5: client 'too posh English'. Every take of '...here already?' says 'already' with the British long rounded vowel (ɔːl), and all 13 r5 takes still classify England 1.00; 'yet' keeps the meaning (Serbian 'već') without that vowel

lines.en: Is Sigismund already here?
lines.tts: Is Sigismund already here?
